rows.note: Use this for an online place where people leave and respond to public messages; it is the all-purpose online choice.

example.english: You can post your views on the website's message board and reply to other users.
example.traditional: 你可以喺網站留言板度發表意見，仲可以回覆其他網友。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 mong5 zaam6 lau4 jin4 baan2 dou6 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3 zung6 ho2 ji5 wui4 fuk1 kei4 taa1 mong5 jau5

rows.note: Use this for a physical public board displaying notices rather than an online site.

example.english: The message board outside the school office has a notice about next week's trip.
example.traditional: 校務處門口嗰塊告示板貼咗下星期旅行嘅通知。
example.jyutping: haau6 mou6 cyu5 mun4 hau2 go2 faai3 gou3 si6 baan2 tip3 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 leoi5 hang4 ge3 tung1 zi1

rows.note: Use this for a board that helps someone communicate, especially an assistive communication board.

example.english: Ming uses a message board to tell the nurse that he is thirsty.
example.traditional: 阿明靠住溝通板同護士講自己口渴。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 kaau3 zyu6 kau1 tung1 baan2 tung4 wu6 si6 gong2 zi6 gei2 hau2 hot3
